config.label: Optional read-only CheapereSIM API token
config.description: Optional read-only CheapereSIM API token. Without it the five plan-search tools work normally. With it, two extra tools can list the eSIMs on your account and their remaining data. Create one at https://cheaperesim.com/dashboard/api-tokens

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://cheaperesim.com and only needs changing for local development.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
